correctness.rationale: Transitivity of every extension forces a lower ideal, an upper filter and strict comparability across them. Conversely these are all the transitivity conditions involving the new vertex, and strict cross-comparability rules out any intersection. The extension property and homogeneity count precisely these diagrams, with no quotient on the named parameters. The independent census added a minimal element with each successor-closed set, canonicalized by all relabelings within directed degree classes, and computed each polynomial using bitsets of ternary assignments subject to every transitivity condition. It reproduced 1,2,5,16,63,318,2045,16999 isomorphism classes, injectivity through seven, and 16,964 distinct polynomials at eight, with 16,933 singleton fibres and 28/2/1 fibres of sizes 2/3/4. The complete frozen catalogue agrees up to isomorphism, not merely in counts. Both displayed witnesses are strict transitive relations; the unique minimal vertex with two strict successors is below the unique maximal vertex with three minimal predecessors in B but not A. The replay verifies their full equal polynomial, total 120, and totals 115/109 and 100/96 for the named C² comparison pairs. The total-degree claim follows since |L|+|U|≤n and one may take (P,∅).
residual_risks: Uploaded code was inspected, not run; the independent implementation used a different canonical quotient and direct ternary grades on every class.
The census does not describe larger orders. The C² comparison is a statement about the specific archived pairs, not general equivalence of logical and polynomial profiles.

evidence: A type corresponds to the ideal with membership sets (L,P\U) in the doubled poset: each copy inherits P and the second-copy p must precede the first-copy q when q is not strictly below p.

value.rationale: The two natural coordinates of an extension diagram distinguish strictly lower and strictly upper named elements, a meaningful refinement of both total type count and one-variable lattice rank. Knowing the first obstruction and every fibre at that boundary tells a researcher precisely when and how the full two-coordinate information ceases to reconstruct the induced base. The explicit comparison with logical indistinguishability shows the different information even at the same cutoff, rather than treating an eight-element coincidence as an explanation.
residual_risks: The value is the exact finite boundary; the result is not a classification of larger collisions or of the full type lattice.
